name: Kamal Skiff Self-Hosted Static Sites
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed open-source static-site deployment tool built on Kamal and nginx with Git-based content updates; no software-hosting quotas when self-hosted.
watch_out: Requires your own server, Docker, Git repository and networking; hosting, domain and bandwidth may cost money. Skiff is a deployment stack, not a free hosted static-site service.
